verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents holding funds in 20 currencies with interbank-rate conversion (docs-16). Global Accounts receive bank transfers into a single Wallet (docs-17, docs-18), and FX conversion is supported at market or guaranteed rates (docs-8, docs-31). Its tooling can also read account balances (docs-13). missing for 10: direct documentation of balance management for the founder's own business account (the 20-currency claim is framed as Banking-as-a-Service for customers), detail on viewing and managing per-currency balances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
